# Configure app token authentication

An app token is a Boundary resource that enables authentication for machine-to-machine interactions. Boundary returns an app token's `token` value
when you create it. You can use it to authenticate requests to Boundary's API or CLI. An app token has a required expiration time, as well as
an optional maximum inactivity time. You can delete an app token or revoke its permissions.

## Create an app token

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="Admin UI" group="ui">

1. Log in to Boundary.
1. Select the scope in which you want to create the app token.
1. Select **App Tokens**, then click **New**.
1. Complete the following fields:
   - **Name**: (Optional) An optional name for identification purposes.
   - **Description**: (Optional) An optional description of the app token.
   - **Time to live (TTL)**: (Required) Duration of the app token.
   - **Time to stale (TTS)**: (Optional) Duration of inactivity after which the app token becomes stale.
   - **Permissions**: (Required) Permissions to set for the app token.
1. Click **Create**.
1. Either copy or download the app token in the pop-up. This is the only time the app token's `token` value is displayed.
  You will not have another opportunity to save it.

</Tab>
<Tab heading="CLI" group="cli">

```shell-session
$ boundary app-tokens create \
  -scope-id $SCOPE_ID \
  -name "example-app-token" \
  -description "An example app token" \
  -time-to-live 30d \
  -permissions file://perms.json
```

Copy the app token's `token` value in the response. This is the only time the app token's `token` value is displayed. You will not 
have another opportunity to save it. 

Refer to the [app-tokens create](/boundary/docs/commands/app-tokens/create) command documentation for more information.

</Tab>
<Tab heading="Terraform" group="terraform">

Apply the following Terraform configuration:

```hcl
resource "boundary_app_token" "appt" {
    # This example assumes that you have stored value of $SCOPE_ID in a Terraform variable
    scope_id              = var.scope_id
    name                  = "example-app-token"
    description           = "An example app token"
    time_to_live_seconds  = 2592000 # 30 days
    permissions           = file("~/perms.json")
}
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

## More information

- Refer to the [App token](/boundary/docs/domain-model/app-tokens) domain model topic to learn more about app tokens.
- Refer to [Permissions in Boundary](/boundary/docs/rbac) to learn more about grants and grant scopes.
- To learn more about managing app tokens, refer to the CLI [`app-tokens`](/boundary/docs/commands/app-tokens) topic or the API [App tokens service](/boundary/api-docs/app-tokens-service) topic.
